Subcontractors receive stacks of tender invitations, each with hundreds of drawings, specifications and a bill of quantities. That means a lot to work through, and most invitations never turn into work. We see it in every country we work in, from the Netherlands to Denmark. At 12Build you own the product that changes that.

We are looking for an AI-native Product Manager for Team Sellers, the team that builds 12Build for subcontractors and suppliers. You have great product taste, are at home in data and already work with AI agents every day. Above all, you love being out with customers and working with people. At 12Build that is how product work gets done.

**The team and the problem**

Team Sellers consists of you, a product designer, a lead developer and developers who work alongside agents. You, the designer and the lead developer lead the team together as a trio. You serve two audiences. Subcontractors use 12Build to find, qualify and respond to invitations from general contractors. Suppliers, the manufacturers and distributors of building materials, use it to get into projects early and to reach their partners. Suppliers are a relatively new audience for us, so there is a lot of discovery ahead.

There is plenty to solve. Subcontractors spend hours deciding which invitations are worth a bid. The information they need is spread over documents, emails and phone calls with the general contractor. And they want to see what the platform brings them. AI changes what we can build for subcontractors and suppliers, and you help decide where it makes the biggest difference.

**How we work**

12Build went AI-first in 2026. Designers, developers and PMs all work with agents, and we keep improving those workflows to shorten the path from customer signal to release. That way of working is far from finished, and as a PM you have a big say in where it goes next.

A few examples of where we stand today:

* Our company knowledge lives in one shared repository, the brain, that people and agents both work from.
* PMs work with Claude, connected to tools like Amplitude, HubSpot, Linear and Slack.
* A weekly signal radar collects customer signals from those sources and turns them into Linear issues with the evidence attached.

The PM decides what to build and why. Agents take on more of the research, synthesis and drafting every month. **Met een marktaandeel van ruim 65% is Forbo wereldwijd marktleider in linoleum. Onder de merknaam Eurocol levert Flooring Systems ook kant-en-klare lijmen voor vloerinstallaties en keramische tegels en nivelleermassa's voor de bouwbranche**

**Stageopdracht Product Management**
------------------------------------

Stageopdracht: vergemakkelijken van de installatie van Marmoleum

  

**Korte samenvatting**

In deze opdracht onderzoek je hoe we het leggen van Marmoleum (linoleum) makkelijker kunnen maken. Niet alleen in de praktijk, maar ook in hoe installateurs dit beleven. Je werkt toe naar concrete hulpmiddelen die installateurs helpen om sneller, makkelijker en met meer vertrouwen te werken.

  

**Achtergrond**

Marmoleum is een sterke en duurzame vloeroplossing. Toch wordt linoleum in de markt soms gezien als lastiger te installeren dan bijvoorbeeld vinyl.

  

Dat beeld kan invloed hebben op de keuze voor Marmoleum. Als installateurs, klanten of architecten denken dat het leggen ingewikkelder is of meer vakkennis vraagt, kan dat een drempel zijn. Zeker nu snelheid belangrijk is en goede vakmensen niet altijd makkelijk te vinden zijn.

  

Forbo wil daarom kijken hoe we installateurs beter kunnen helpen. Niet door Marmoleum zelf te veranderen, maar door te kijken naar handige hulpmiddelen, tools, uitleg en ondersteuning rond het installatieproces.

  

**Probleemstelling**

De installatie van Marmoleum wordt regelmatig gezien als specialistisch. De vraag is of dat beeld klopt, waar het vandaan komt en welke onderdelen van het werk echt lastig zijn. Ook als de perceptie niet altijd terecht is, kan die wel invloed hebben op de keuze voor Marmoleum.

  

In deze opdracht kijk je daarom naar twee dingen: wat er in de praktijk beter kan en welke aannames of beelden er zijn rond het installeren van Marmoleum. We’re live with **Santander, Revolut, BBVA** and dozens others. We’ve proven the product in large-scale pilots with top-tier banks. And now we need to move fast to **secure leadership in this $300Bn+ industry**.

#### **About the team**

Our mid-market customers need a collections agent that works within weeks. To do that for many customers at once, we rely on standard workflows, reusable components and strong tooling, tuned to each customer segment.

Forward Deployed Engineers on the mid-market team launch these agents and keep improving the system behind them. Each launch should be faster and more reliable than the last.

You configure agents on Murphy's platform using our templates, adapt them to each customer, and test them before launch. After go-live, you track how each agent performs, explain the results to the customer, and tune the agent and contact strategy. Over time, you improve those templates and tools so the whole team can deliver more with less effort.

This is also where new FDEs at Murphy learn the craft. Strong mid-market FDEs move on to our enterprise team, which builds custom deployments for banks.

**You'll be based in Amsterdam and launch agents for lenders, telcos, utilities, healthcare providers and servicers in the Netherlands.**

#### **About the team**

Collections agents only work in production when someone owns the build in detail. Each one handles regulated conversations, sensitive customer situations and payment outcomes, and has to behave correctly every time.

Forward Deployed Engineers own that build. They turn a customer's collections strategy, policies and systems into a working agent, prove it in a POC, and take it to full production. They work with Account Executives during the sale, with Deployment Strategists after go-live, and with Product and Engineering to make the platform better with every deployment.

#### **About the role**

As a Forward Deployed Engineer, you own the technical execution of AI agent builds for our enterprise customers, mainly banks and large lenders. You scope with the customer's technical and operations leads, design the agent, build and test it, and launch it on their systems. After launch, you own the agent's performance: you analyze production data, explain results to the customer, and decide what to change in the agent and the contact strategy. Each deployment should leave behind patterns, tools and tests that make the next one faster.

**You'll be based in Amsterdam and lead enterprise deployments for banks and large lenders in the Netherlands.**

#### **In this role, you will**

* Own end-to-end delivery of enterprise agent builds, from POC scoping through implementation, evaluation and production launch.
* Define the agent operating procedures (actions, guardrails, escalations) with the customer, and turn them into agent behavior.
* Design and engineer the prompt and agent logic that drives identification, negotiation and payment conversations, across languages and channels.
* Configure Murphy to fit each client’s needs on how and when to reach debtors: call windows, retry and frequency rules within each country's regulations, channel mix (voice, SMS, RCS, WhatsApp), payment links and hand-offs to human agents.
* Build evaluation and simulation harnesses, plus regression tests against real call outcomes, to catch errors and drift before customers do.
* Build, validate and maintain integrations with customer systems: core banking, collections platforms, data pipelines, telephony.
* Diagnose failures from transcripts, traces and logs, find the root cause, and fix it in the agent or flag it to Engineering.

**This is a hybrid position which requires 8 days per month in the office. You can be based in any one of our offices in Washington, D.C, London, The Hague or Mexico City.**

**Existing work authorization is required at the time of application submission as WRI is unable to sponsor any visa work sponsorship for this position. To be eligible for this position in US, you must be a resident of DC, Maryland or Virginia at the start of employment.**

**About the Program: Global Restoration Initiative**:

WRI’s Global Restoration Initiative informs, enables, and invests in people restoring degraded land, with its flagship TerraFund program supporting over 200 enterprises and community nonprofits across Africa, Latin America, and South Asia. The Restore Local initiative advances this work through a $60M+ portfolio of locally led projects across priority landscapes in Africa, Brazil, and India. The portfolio spans grant funding, as well as debt and equity investments in SMEs and blended finance structures.

In its next phase, WRI’s Restoration team is leveraging technology and its growing network of local partners to develop scalable finance solutions that mobilize greater public and private capital, delivering measurable outcomes for people, nature, and climate. We are making significant investment in our software products and analytical services to support our work to dramatically increase (from millions to billions of dollars) our ability to bring money to the ground for local restoration. This is an exciting opportunity for someone passionate about applying data innovation and software solutions to mobilize finance for nature-positive solutions and sustainable economic development.

Restoring the world’s 2 billion degraded hectares is currently held back by fragmented, small-scale efforts and a persistent mismatch between local restoration champions — community groups, cooperatives, and NGOs — and the large-scale investors and governments who could fund and scale their work. Our new platform concept, RestorationWorks, has the ambition of closing that gap by bringing the full restoration journey onto one platform: connecting practitioners, funders, and governments; embedding WRI’s locally-led restoration methodology into intuitive digital workflows; and centralizing restoration intelligence — case studies, best practices, and AI-powered geospatial data — to equip any stakeholder in our ecosystem with the tools they need to do restoration well.

The Data Lab is WRI’s core data innovation and delivery unit. We are a team of over 50 engineers, product managers, and data scientists with deep experience setting data strategy, doing quantitative research, and building data tools and products. We work across WRI’s programs, centers and international offices to use advances in data and technology to help our community improve lives, protect nature, and ensure just transitions.
